text:
maya: Heads-up  we need a compact creative pack for the upcoming "Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale" (next Wed). Not a full campaign, just a quick deliverable set for organic + paid. Can design take on a small sprint?

jon: yes. what do you need specifically?

maya: essentials: 1) animated hero GIF (1200x628, loop, 5s) 2) three static benchmark cards (1080x1080) focused on latency, cost, and reliability 3) LinkedIn ad crop (1200x627) 4) vertical mobile crop (1080x1350) 5) SVG icon set (clock, coin, shield) 6) one deck title slide (16:9) with editable text/placeholders. Also need Figma with components + export-ready assets.

tara: timelines?

maya: we need draft by Fri 5pm PT so growth can queue assets for next week's schedule. Final by Mon.

design-ops-bot: Created project file: https://figma.redwood/app/file/1/WebinarMiniPack_v2 (comments enabled). Starter templates included: hero, social, deck.

jon: style guidelines  brand palette plus a complementary warm accent for CTAs. Avoid heavy illustration; prefer geometric iconography. Use Inter and Source Sans for body.

maya: copy for cards (short):
- Latency: "~90ms median — consistent, low-latency inference."
- Cost: "$0.40 per 1k tokens — predictable unit economics."
- Reliability: "99.95% uptime on Dedicated clusters."

jon: add subtle sparklines behind the numbers (low visual weight). For animated GIF: simple morph from latency -> cost -> reliability with a label highlight. Keep filesize small (<1.5MB).

tara: legal note: include micro-caption "Internal Redwood benchmarks, Apr 2026. Your results may vary." Also require alt-text drafts for each image.

legal: alt text and micro-caption required. Also request we avoid any specific customer names or logos.

jon: export specs: PNGs at requested sizes (x2 light/dark), GIF (1200x628) + MP4 fallback for paid channels, SVG icons, layered PSD for hero, and a Figma component library. Naming convention: webinar2026_<asset>_<variant>.png

maya: can we also get one A/B variant for hero: CTA text "Watch the Webinar" vs "See the Benchmarks"? Growth wants quick A/B.

jon: yep include both CTA copies as separate frames.

design-ops-bot: I added task checklist in Figma and set due date Fri 17:00 PT. Comments enabled for review.

maya: localization note: we'll need placeholders for Spanish copy (same layout). We won't translate now but design must allow easy text swaps.

jon: estimate: 5	6 hours design + 2 hours QA/exports + 1 hour animations = ~8	7 hours. Can do draft by Fri evening.

tara: I'll review Fri night and flag any legal/brand issues. If anything major, we may push final to Tue.

maya: perfect. please ping here when draft uploaded. Also include a short README in the Figma file with export instructions and naming conventions.

design-ops-bot: Draft frames uploaded to Figma page "MiniPack / Drafts". Please review and comment. Exports queued in the Figma export panel.

jon: uploaded GIF and export proofs to the file.

maya: quick note for paid ops  include an extra 1200x1200 square for carousel use.

jon: added 1200x1200 export.

legal: branding compliance check: ensure logo clearspace >=16px and color contrast meets AA for body text. Added comment on Figma.

maya: thanks team. routing to growth once we have sign-off.
